prompts.name: start
prompts.description: Orient and start working in this project.
prompts.body:
You are working in **chronos-forge-omnibus** (`library`, `typescript`).

First call `chronos_overview` — it is the canonical map of this server's tools, plugins and a `recommendedNextAction`. Follow the recommendation.

## Project shape

- Type: `library`
- Framework: _(none detected)_
- Monorepo tool: _(none)_
- Test runner: `node`
- Package manager: `npm`

## Quality gates

- `lint` → `eslint . --max-warnings=0`
- `test` → `node --test --import ./test/register.ts test/`
- `build` → `tsc -p tsconfig.json`
- `typecheck` → `tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit`
- `clean` → `node -e "fs.rmSync('dist',{recursive:true,force:true})"`
- `test:watch` → `node --test --watch --import ./test/register.ts test/`
- `verify` → `npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test`
- `dev` → `node --watch --import ./scripts/dev-loader.ts scripts/dev.ts`
- `chronos:bootstrap` → `node --import ./scripts/dev-loader.ts scripts/bootstrap.ts`
- `chronos:cycle` → `node --import ./scripts/dev-loader.ts scripts/cycle.ts`

## When you change the project

1. Re-run `chronos_analyze_project` to refresh the analysis.
2. If the project grew (new scripts, new framework deps, new monorepo packages), call `chronos_plan_mcp_project` to refresh the blueprint and `chronos_create_project` to materialise the new tools.
3. Never invent tool names; only call what `overview` lists.

prompts.name: fix quality
prompts.description: Run the gates and fix what fails.
prompts.body:
Run the project quality gates in this order and fix what fails:
1. `lint` → `eslint . --max-warnings=0`
1. `test` → `node --test --import ./test/register.ts test/`
1. `build` → `tsc -p tsconfig.json`
1. `typecheck` → `tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit`
1. `clean` → `node -e "fs.rmSync('dist',{recursive:true,force:true})"`
1. `test:watch` → `node --test --watch --import ./test/register.ts test/`
1. `verify` → `npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test`
1. `dev` → `node --watch --import ./scripts/dev-loader.ts scripts/dev.ts`
1. `chronos:bootstrap` → `node --import ./scripts/dev-loader.ts scripts/bootstrap.ts`
1. `chronos:cycle` → `node --import ./scripts/dev-loader.ts scripts/cycle.ts`

If a gate is broken because of an external dep (downstream service, network, missing env), record it as `external-gate-blocker` with the evidence and continue.
